label: RECORDING of a Seeded Ode build, not a live run. Label it as a recording wherever it is shown.

friends.name: Tharun
friends.insideJoke: Drove the overnight stretch to Key West while everyone slept

friends.name: Vikram
friends.insideJoke: Got us lost, ending with key lime pie at a random pier

friends.name: Sahiti
friends.insideJoke: Screamed when the alligator came close to the airboat

lines.text: Tharun, you held the wheel while the whole car fell asleep
Through the dark and the bridges, the long road south to Key West
We woke to the ocean glowing and you were smiling still
You carried us through the night, and we won't forget it, friend
Vikram, you swore you knew the way, then the road just disappeared
We wandered past the mangroves, laughing louder every mile
Ended up on a random pier with key lime pie in hand
Best wrong turn we ever took, you led us somewhere sweet
Sahiti, on the airboat, the swamp was calm and green
Then that alligator drifted close and you let out a scream
The whole boat burst out laughing, even the gator seemed to grin
Your voice still echoes in the glades, we love you for that sound

hook.text: Thank you, friends, for carrying me along this ride

chorus.text: From the midnight road to the swamp and the pier, every mile was better with you here
